questions.question: Confirm the implementation scope and version strategy: retain one distributable jar for Minecraft 26.3 and 26.2, using shared APIs/metadata or compatibility shims where feasible, and flag any incompatibility that prevents one jar rather than silently producing separate jars. The requested feature order is (1) remove weapon attack cooldown/delay and tool/armor durability, (2) SkyBlock-style player and mob health stats, (3) server-style mob levels, (4) stats for vanilla armor, then continue. Use the Hypixel SkyBlock Fandom wiki as the primary feature reference; custom armor helmets need corresponding custom heads. Is this correct, and do you have any extra implementation constraints?
questions.recommendedChoice: Proceed with the stated feature order and one-jar 26.3/26.2 target; surface compatibility blockers explicitly.
questions.answer: Yes. One identical jar for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3 is mandatory. Use shared APIs/metadata or compatibility shims where feasible, and report any blocker rather than producing separate jars.
questions.rationale: The user explicitly confirmed that the same jar is a hard requirement.
